origin.description: Lilliefors Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric vector with more than 4 non-missing values. Missing values are dropped.

origin.details: D is the larger of max(i/n - p) and max(p - (i-1)/n), where p is the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics. The p-value is the Dallal-Wilkinson formula when that approximation is at most 0.1, and Stephens' polynomial otherwise. For n above 100 the Dallal-Wilkinson statistic is scaled by (n/100)^0.49 and evaluated at n = 100.
origin.value: An htest list with statistic D, the p-value, the method, and the data name.

translation.description: Lilliefors Kolmogorov-Smirnov test of the composite hypothesis of normality.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Numeric values with more than 4 non-missing entries. NaN is dropped.

translation.details: D is the larger of max(i/n - p) and max(p - (i-1)/n), where p is the normal cdf of the standardized order statistics. The p-value is the Dallal-Wilkinson formula when that approximation is at most 0.1, and Stephens' polynomial otherwise. For n above 100 the Dallal-Wilkinson statistic is scaled by (n/100)^0.49 and evaluated at n = 100. The cdf is math.erf.
translation.value: An htest object with statistic D, the p-value, the method, and the data name.
translation.example:
from nortest import lillie_test

x = [2.1, 3.4, float("nan"), 1.2, 5.6, 4.0, 3.3, 2.8, 6.1, 1.9, float("nan"), 4.4]
print(lillie_test(x), end="")
